prose: In his UN General Assembly speech, President Trump rejected what he called a 'globalist scheme to control' AI, the Financial Times reports. He said the US is 'leading now over China by a lot and everyone else, and we're going to keep it that way.'
highlights: Trump used his UNGA speech to reject a 'globalist scheme to control' AI.
He claimed the US leads China 'by a lot' in AI.
The remarks signal US resistance to internationally coordinated AI governance.
